executive_summary: During Fiscal Week 202719, total demand across the Combined Queue (Brazil Cons Basic SITEL) changed by +22.2%. However, Voice (Brazil Cons Basic) demand increased by 112 contacts. This indicates that customers chose different contact channels rather than demand reducing. Because the forecast was generated independently for each Forecast Name instead of the CQN, over-forecast and under-forecast errors occurred across individual channels.
business_impact: The under-forecast error resulted in a higher than expected volume of 617 contacts, which may impact the queue's ability to handle the increased demand efficiently.

ranked_root_causes.title: Inherited from Higher Level
ranked_root_causes.explanation: The miss is already visible at the Region level, so it is not specific to this queue and should be attributed there. During Fiscal Week 202719, the Region (CSG / Americas) had an actual offered volume of 23135.0 and a forecasted offered volume of 20539.8, resulting in an adherence percentage of -12.6%. This indicates that the under-forecast error is not specific to the Brazil Cons Basic queue but is a broader issue affecting the Region.

evidence.text: The INVESTIGATION_LADDER shows that the miss is already visible at the Region level.

ranked_root_causes.business_impact: The under-forecast error at the Region level may impact the ability of the queues within the Region to handle the increased demand efficiently.
ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Review the forecast at the Region level to identify the root cause of the under-forecast error.

ranked_root_causes.title: Installed Base Change
ranked_root_causes.explanation: The installed base (Final_upp_units) has increased by 28% compared to the usual level, which may have contributed to the under-forecast error. During Fiscal Week 202719, the installed base was 6768.0, which is higher than the usual level of 5293.4. This increase in installed base may have led to a higher than expected volume of 617 contacts.
ranked_root_causes.business_impact: The increase in installed base may have contributed to the under-forecast error, and reviewing the installed base assumptions may help to improve the forecast accuracy.
ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Review the installed base assumptions to ensure they are accurate and up-to-date.
